title: Choose the app's new world
question: The roll assigned The marquee. Keep it, take my pick or the grid, re-roll, or take the category standard played straight.

options.label: The marquee
options.lineage: a venue's backlit letterboard marquee, tonight's bill in black slotted letters
options.thesis: Tonight's tone, spelled in lights: the preset and scene sit on a backlit marquee you can read from across the room.
materials: amber bulb light for what's on
options.viewport: A full-width marquee spells TECH DEATH and SCENE 2 LEAD; under it the scene buttons, then what's on, the amp, and four hands-on knobs.
options.risk: Reads as a novelty if the letters spell anything but real names, or if the marquee spreads past its one strip.

raised.raise: Every amp head is drawn at one fixed scale and baseline on every page, so switching amps compares like for like.
A performance view where the current scene owns the screen and the next one is one key away.
Values sit right-aligned in tabular columns, like running times against a margin.
The dark grounds come from one strict nine-step tonal ramp, nothing in between.
Work areas divide by flat tonal fields, not boxes and borders.

options.label: The setlist
options.lineage: the setlist taped to the stage floor, read from the guitar
options.thesis: The rig as tonight's setlist: presets in order down a taped strip, the current one circled, readable at a glance while you play.
materials: a paper strip as the preset rail
a red circle on the current preset
options.viewport: A paper rail down the left lists the presets in order, the current one circled with its scenes under it; the amp, what's on and the knobs fill the stage-black field.
options.risk: The most familiar idea for a band tool; paper and marker tip into costume if they reach past the rail.

options.label: The grid specimen
options.thesis: A visible construction grid holds every control, and the preset name is built from the same cells, monumental and readable across the room.
options.viewport: The preset name assembled from grid cells across the top; the controls snap to the same cells below, what's on as lit cells in one strip.
options.case: Fuses well: a grid suits a dense control screen and math rock's Swiss-grid covers; loses narrowly on audience identification for most guitarists.
options.risk: Grid-built letters read slowly for long names, and the grid turns to wallpaper if it stops holding real controls.

options.label: Botanical folio
options.lineage: a botanical folio of one plant through its seasons
options.thesis: Each amp as a plate at one fixed scale.
options.viewport: Plates of the amps side by side.
options.risk: Guitarists don't see themselves in a herbarium.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no audience identification, and plates fight a control screen.
options.kept: One fixed scale and baseline for every amp head.

options.label: Vertical video feed
options.thesis: One scene owns the screen at a time.
options.viewport: The scene full screen with a rail of actions.
options.risk: Reads as a social app, not an audio tool.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a feed's grammar misleads in a pro tool.
options.kept: The current scene owns the screen; the next is one key away.

options.label: Zoo guide map
options.lineage: a gardens guide map of flat colour lobes
options.case: Fuses poorly: lobes hide the chain's order.
options.kept: Areas divide by flat fields, not borders.

options.label: Cassette j-card
options.thesis: Presets as side A and side B tracklists.
options.viewport: The tracklist as the preset list.
options.risk: Handwriting is a costume on a working screen.
options.case: Fuses poorly: ballpoint lines can't carry live state.

options.label: Darkroom exposure record
options.viewport: Translucent sheets over a zone ramp.
options.risk: A darkroom means nothing to most players.
options.case: Fuses poorly: hatching reads as noise next to audio meters.
options.kept: One strict tonal ramp for every neutral.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What amp sims ship, done impeccably: a dark stage with photoreal amps, a pedal row, a preset bar on top, an inspector on the right.
canonCard.viewport: A preset bar, the amp on a dark stage, a pedal row under it, an inspector with the selected block's knobs at the right.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
